name: idc-skills-forge
anchor: No authority without evidence. The skills demonstrate their own discipline.
dualHarness: Every island ships an agents/openai.yaml sidecar; user-invoked islands carry policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false so disable-model-invocation travels to Codex.

skills.name: idc-skill-authoring
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej effective-agent-skills + Pocock writing-great-skills (v1.2 refactor) + IDC fleet distribution
skills.summary: The skill layer of the canon — folder anatomy, progressive disclosure, invocation and router skills, the Codex openai.yaml sidecar, fleet distribution, and the evidence discipline. Points to writing-for-agents for the universal levers.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.provenance: NEW v1.2 — Pocock writing-for-agents; the universal source of truth the canon points to
skills.summary: The universal levers for any document an agent reads — context pointers, the two loads, information hierarchy, completion criteria, leading words, pruning, and failure modes. Fires when editing AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / rules files.
triggers: make this agent doc read better

skills.name: cross-family-review
skills.provenance: CROWN — fusion: Ondrej fable/gpt-review + Pocock code-review two-axis + Garnet review ceremony
skills.summary: The crown ceremony: an independent reviewer from a different model family reviews a diff at an exact head along Standards and Spec axes and returns a named-seat verdict that voids on move. The author never reviews their own work.

skills.name: worktree-fleet
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej git-worktree + IDC §02 admissibility boundary
skills.summary: Git worktrees for same-machine parallel agents, with the IDC boundary: adopted for drafts, forbidden for evidence. Worktree artifacts are inadmissible as gate evidence until re-derived from a fresh clone.

skills.name: grill
skills.provenance: fusion: Pocock grill-me/grilling/batch-grill-me (v1.2 rounds + emoji scan) + Ondrej prompt-me + IDC ADR emission
skills.summary: Relentless interview to reach shared understanding before building, in three modes (ambush, drill, batch), emitting settled decisions as ADRs. Facts are looked up; only decisions are asked.

skills.name: agent-guardrails
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej global-agent-guardrails + Pocock git-guardrails/setup-pre-commit + read-only db role
skills.summary: Four mechanical layers under an AI fleet — shell denylist, git block, pre-commit gate, read-only data role — mechanizing the covenants beneath the prompts.

skills.name: handoff
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej handoff + Pocock handoff/claude-handoff + IDC wake protocol
skills.summary: Compact a session into a state-based handoff a fresh agent resumes from with zero memory, plus the wake protocol the receiver runs — re-reading verdicts and register state from the tree before trusting the summary.

skills.name: lane-claim
skills.provenance: IDC-ONLY — Garnet boot step 6 (declare-and-halt fleet coordination)
skills.summary: Declare-and-halt coordination for agents working one repo across many machines: claim a lane before touching it, halt if already claimed, release when done. Cures the cross-machine collisions worktrees cannot.

skills.name: transport-complete
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej prod-push + IDC transport covenant
skills.summary: Ship a change and babysit it until verifiably live — commit, push, watch CI, confirm the deploy promoted the exact SHA, prove production serves it. Done means a health check for the exact SHA, not a successful push.

skills.name: spec-pipeline
skills.provenance: fusion: Pocock to-spec/to-tickets/implement + Ondrej goal-loop as persistent runner
skills.summary: One pipeline from a discussed feature to shipped code: spec (synthesis) then tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges, implement at pre-agreed seams with TDD, then an optional persistent goal loop.

skills.name: research
skills.provenance: fusion: Ondrej deep-research/research-prompt + Pocock research (primary-source discipline)
skills.summary: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture findings as a cited Markdown file — every claim sourced or explicitly flagged unverified. DeepAPI is an optional backend.
triggers: gather primary-source facts into a cited file

skills.name: finding-register
skills.provenance: IDC-ONLY — the U-series discipline
skills.summary: A durable register of findings each enumerated at an exact SHA (not a running count), provenance-marked in both directions, and given a collision-free id swept before allocation.

skills.name: deep-modules
skills.provenance: Pocock codebase-design + setup-ts-deep-modules, adapted
skills.summary: Shared vocabulary and enforcement for deep modules — a lot of behaviour behind a small interface at a clean seam — with the dependency-cruiser rules that make entry points the only way in.

skills.name: diagnose
skills.provenance: Pocock diagnosing-bugs + IDC operation-counts law
skills.summary: A disciplined loop for hard bugs: build a tight red-capable feedback loop first, reproduce and minimise, hypothesise, instrument, fix with a regression test, post-mortem. Performance is judged by operation counts, not wall-clock.

skills.name: archipelago
skills.provenance: Jon's existing protocol (Navigata1/archipelago), reviewed against the canon
skills.summary: The full-cycle, evidence-gated build protocol — typed contracts at every seam, gates that must be able to fail, loopback routing, a tamper-evident ledger, and band caps you cannot talk your way past.

skills.name: domain-wire
skills.provenance: IDC-NATIVE — the IDC domain doctrine (three-lane model, graduation, governance rules)
skills.summary: Wire a domain the IDC way — the three-lane model (story / product / AI-native), one canonical per venture with siblings 308-redirecting to it, automatic graduation when a brand deed exists, and canonicals moving in the same commit.
triggers: set up DNS for a venture

skills.name: console-as-code
skills.provenance: IDC-NATIVE — named in the Garnet×Buzz synthesis as the first IDC-skills candidate to graduate into Garnet ops
skills.summary: Assemble an agent's operating prompt from versioned in-repo blocks (BOOT, covenants, lanes, seats), stamped with the assembly SHA, so every prompt is an auditable artifact and the same console assembles identically on every seat.

skills.name: evidence-packet
skills.provenance: IDC-NATIVE — the Contributor-Road artifact from the Two Roads synthesis
skills.summary: Assemble a byte-verifiable evidence packet — the diff, the verification-ladder commands, and their captured outputs — so a reviewer recomputes every claim instead of trusting the author. A weak and a frontier author are equally mergeable when both can run the ladder.

skills.name: wizard
skills.provenance: NEW v1.2 — Pocock wizard (bundled template.sh library)
skills.summary: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform — opening each URL, saying what to click, capturing values, and writing them into .env files and GitHub Actions secrets. Ships a fixed template.sh UX library.
triggers: set up credentials or CI secrets

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.provenance: NEW v1.2 — Pocock to-questionnaire (the inverse of grill)
skills.summary: Turn a decision you can't answer alone into a Markdown questionnaire for the one person who can — filled in async or worked through together. Grills you about the send (who it goes to, what you need back), not the subject.
triggers: I need someone else to answer this
turn this into a doc for a stakeholder

skills.name: wait-what
skills.provenance: NEW v1.2 — Pocock wait-what, grounded in the forge CONTEXT.md ubiquitous language
skills.summary: Stop — that last message did not land. Re-pitch it with the missing context, in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, grounded in the project's own CONTEXT.md ubiquitous language.

skills.name: short
skills.provenance: adopt: Ondrej short
skills.summary: Compress the current answer — strip filler, simplify wording, cut length while keeping substance.

skills.name: teach
skills.provenance: adopt/dedupe: Pocock teach (attributed)
skills.summary: A stateful multi-session teaching workspace — mission-grounded lessons from high-trust sources, delivered as beautiful self-contained HTML with tight feedback loops and learning records.
